codes.2: Interstate not on the Primary Highway Freight System

signs: SIGN1 from the source with spaces and control characters taken out: I for interstate, U for US route, S for state route, C for county route, then the number and any suffix (I35E, U9W). Null where the source has none.
encoding: pts is [x0, y0, dx1, dy1, ...] in units of 10^-precision degrees, lon then lat. Add each pair to the vertex before it to get the next one.
